artist_scope: full contract (Tier 2, the state-branching class (an attacking branch on the mouth; client-side random latches on the legs and mouth): geckolib_migration_design.md section 5); the rig is not yet in-game (it lands through the seam in a later slice)
character_sheet: A flying six-legged horror with a four-way mouth: a body, a head, a thorax and an abdomen; four jaw petals around the head - a right, a left, an upper and a lower jaw, each a jaw plate, a second plate and six teeth - that open outward in two pairs; a three-part tongue that shoots forward as the mouth opens; six legs hanging under it (the four front and middle legs in three parts, the two rear in two) and four wing blades (LurkingTerrorModel.java; 59 parts on a 256x64 sheet). It is hostile to nearly everything alive and in sight - a long list of fellow flyers and plants excepted (EntityLurkingTerror.java:229-252) - within 12 blocks (:211-212): it flies at the target, raises the synched attacking flag (:163) and bites for 6 within 2.4 blocks (:165-167, doHurtTarget); 30 HP, 5 armour (MobStats.LURKING_TERROR, :66-73). It has no goals at all: its flight is its own - random air spots (:142-159), the motion eased toward them (:173-181), the yaw turned a quarter of the way per tick (:183-185), the vertical motion damped to 0.6 (:116-120) - and a hit turns it on its attacker (:197-206); its own kind cannot hurt it (:200). It spawns in dark spots by DAY, above y 10, never near another (:254-266). Read it as a hovering insect nightmare: wings buzzing, legs twitching one at a time, the four jaws flaring open and the tongue lashing out when it attacks.
size_notes: Drawn at x0.85 of the rig (LurkingTerrorRenderer.java:21, 34) on a 256x64 sheet (LurkingTerrorModel.java:443); the hitbox is 1.75 x 1.25 (ModEntities.java:262-264); shadow 0.45 x 0.85 (LurkingTerrorRenderer.java:23).

groups.name: wings
groups.amplitude: +0.455 rad rest (26 deg), then pi x 0.2 = 0.628 rad (36 deg); the rear pair beats opposite to the front pair
groups.plain: the four wing blades buzz fore and aft, the front pair and the rear pair in opposition
groups.math: w = cos(t * 1.4 * 1.0) * pi * 0.2; wing_1.xRot = wing_2.xRot = 0.455 + w; wing_3.xRot = wing_4.xRot = 0.455 - w
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.4 x 1.0 (wingspeed, LurkingTerrorModel.java:21): the natural period is 2 pi / 1.4 = 4.5 ticks

groups.name: breath
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.06 = 0.188 rad (11 deg) on the thorax's pitch; the abdomen's height follows it (14 x sin of the angle, up to 2.6 units)
groups.plain: a slow breathing: the thorax rocks and the abdomen rides up and down with it
groups.math: b = sin(t * 0.1 * 1.0) * pi * 0.06; thorax.xRot = b; abdomen.y = thorax.y - sin(b) * 14
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.1 x 1.0 (a sine, a quarter period behind the cosine form): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.1 = 62.8 ticks

groups.name: legs
groups.amplitude: rests +-0.191 rad (hips and second parts) and +-0.675 (front and middle feet), +-0.34 (rear legs); then pi x 0.25 = 0.785 rad (45 deg) on the front legs, pi x 0.15 = 0.471 (27 deg) on the middle, pi x 0.1 = 0.314 (18 deg) on the rear - each leg only in the cycles a client-side roll picks it (1 in 3 front, 1 in 4 middle, 1 in 6 rear)
groups.plain: the six legs twitch sideways one at a time: at each cycle boundary a roll picks which legs swing this cycle, the rest hang still
groups.math: s = sin(t * 0.7 * 1.0); leg2/leg2part2.zRot = 0.191 + (bit0 ? s * pi * 0.25 : 0), leg2part3 = 0.675 + the same; leg1 mirrored (-0.191 / -0.675, bit1); leg4 (+) / leg3 (-) with bits 2 / 3 at pi * 0.15; leg6 (-0.34, bit4) / leg5 (+0.34, bit5) at pi * 0.1
groups.phase: a per-entity latch (RenderInfo ri1, rolled at each 9-tick cycle boundary, LurkingTerrorModel.java:459-479) selects the legs; not a server state
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.7 x 1.0 (a sine): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.7 = 9 ticks

groups.name: mouth
groups.axis: y (right and left jaws) / x (upper and lower jaws); the tongue slides along z
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.35 = 1.1 rad (63 deg), rectified (|sin|: a full flare and shut twice per natural period); the tongue pieces slide 5 and 10 units forward per radian (up to 5.5 and 11 units); ONLY while the latch is set - every cycle while attacking, 1 cycle in 20 at random when calm, otherwise shut
groups.plain: the four jaw petals flare open outward together - right and left sideways, upper and lower up and down - and the tongue shoots forward with them; constantly while attacking, a rare twitch when calm
groups.math: m = latch ? abs(sin(t * 0.9 * 1.0) * pi * 0.35) : 0; jaw1 (+ part2, teeth).yRot = m; jaw2 (...).yRot = -m; jaw3 (...).xRot = -m; jaw4 (...).xRot = m; tonguepart1.z = tonguepart2.z - m * 5; tonguepart3.z = tonguepart2.z - m * 10
groups.phase: the attacking flag forces the latch every cycle (LurkingTerrorModel.java:487-489, EntityLurkingTerror.java:163); calm, a client-side 1-in-20 roll per 7-tick cycle (:484-486)
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.9 x 1.0 (a sine, rectified): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.9 = 7 ticks, the visible flare every 3.5

behaviour: Four wing blades buzz at all times (LurkingTerrorModel.java:570-574): the cosine of the age x 1.4 (wingspeed 1.0, :21), x pi x 0.2 - 36 degrees around a 26-degree rest every 4.5 ticks - added to the front pair and subtracted from the rear pair.

The thorax breathes (:568-569): the sine of the age x 0.1, x pi x 0.06 (11 degrees every 62.8 ticks) pitches it, and the abdomen's height follows (14 units x the sine of that angle, about 2.6 units) - a position key on the abdomen.

The legs twitch at random (:453, :457-480, :493-525): at every boundary of the 9-tick leg cycle a per-entity latch rolls six bits (1 in 3 for each front leg, 1 in 4 for each middle, 1 in 6 for each rear); a leg whose bit is set swings sideways this cycle - the sine of the age x 0.7 x pi x 0.25 (front, 45 deg), 0.15 (middle, 27 deg) or 0.1 (rear, 18 deg) added to its rest (+-0.191 rad on the hips, +-0.675 on the front and middle feet, +-0.34 on the rear legs); the others hang still. A client-side roll, not a server state.

The mouth (:454, :481-491, :527-567): a second latch on the 7-tick mouth cycle is set every cycle while the synched attacking flag is up (:487-489) and in 1 cycle in 20 at random when calm (:484-486); while set, the absolute value of the sine of the age x 0.9 x pi x 0.35 (63 degrees, a flare every 3.5 ticks) yaws the right jaw open and the left jaw open the other way and pitches the upper jaw up and the lower jaw down - each jaw's second plate and six teeth copying it - and slides the tongue's first piece 5 and its tip 10 units forward per radian (up to 5.5 and 11 units); the tongue's own rotations are zeroed. Latch clear: the jaws sit shut on their +-0.41 rad rests and the tongue is home.

The body and head never move; nothing scales with walking speed and nothing reads the look. The visible travel is the entity's own flight (EntityLurkingTerror.java:136-185): random air spots, the motion eased toward them, a hit redirecting it at the attacker (:197-206).

The attacking flag is held: set 1 every ninth think tick while a target is found (EntityLurkingTerror.java:160-164) and 0 when none is (:169) - a state, so the bite (doHurtTarget :166, within 2.4 blocks) is transport 1.
